candidates.name: Kettlebell Russian Twist
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Russian Twist
Novice
1
Sit on the floor with your legs bent, knees together and feet raised slightly off the floor.
2
Starting on one side and sitting up straight with your core muscles engaged, lift the kettlebell off the floor with both hands and bring it across your body to the other side, rotating your chest towards the floor as you do so.
3
Tap the kettlebell lightly on the floor and bring the kettlebell back across your body to the starting position, rotating your chest towards the floor.
4
Repeat, keeping the legs bent and feet raised throughout the exercise.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Windmill
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Windmill
Advanced
1
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in one hand and extend your arm above your head.
2
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell above your head, lower the relaxed arm towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
3
Return to the starting potion, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Situp
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Situp
Beginner
1
Lay flat on your back with straight legs and hold the kettle bell above your chest at arms length.
2
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor with the kettlebell raised at arms length above your chest.
3
Return to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Start in a bench press position with your legs elevated. Try to keep your knees with a slight bend in them.
2
Lower kettlebells toward chest while keeping legs elevated and torso stable.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without arching lower back.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Larsen Press
Intermediate
1
Lie on bench with feet off floor, holding one kettlebell above chest.
2
Lower kettlebell toward chest while keeping core tight and legs raised.
3
Press upward, squeezing chest at the top without twisting torso.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Windmill Bottom Hand
Intermediate
1
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart. Hold the kettlebell in your bottom hand and extend the other arm above your head.
2
Keeping your legs straight and the kettlebell inside your thigh, lower the kettlebell towards the ground, twisting your body towards the side of the raised arm.
3
Return to the starting position, tilt your pelvis forward and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Step Up
Advanced
1
Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold kettlebells at your shoulders.
2
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Step Up
Advanced
1
Stand in front of a step or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a kettlebell at one shoulder.
2
Step up onto the bench with your right foot, pushing off your foot to raise your body up onto the bench.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Front Rack Forward Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack position.
2
Step forward, lunge. Bringing your back knee to the floor.
3
Extend your knee and return to the starting position.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Squat
Beginner
1
Hold kettlebells close to chest.
2
Squat down, keeping chest up.
3
Stand up, extending hips fully.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Single Arm Lateral Lunge
Intermediate
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step sideways, lunge.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Reverse Lunge (Double)
Intermediate
1
Start with kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step back into lunge.
3
Return to start position.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Lateral Lunge (Double)
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebell in front rack.
2
Step sideways into a lunge position.
3
Return to start position. Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Forward Lunge (Double)
Intermediate
1
Start with kettlebells in front rack.
2
Step forward into lunge.
3
Return to starting position.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Front Rack Curtsy Lunge (Double)
Advanced
1
Hold kettlebells in front rack.
2
Step back and lunge diagonally.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Hollow Hold
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Hollow Hold
Advanced
1
Grab a kettlebell.
2
Lie on your back, lift legs & shoulders off floor.
3
Hold kettlebell above your head, engage core, and maintain position.
